title: driver-turso remote: schema sync adds a new storage.notNull field to a populated table as ADD COLUMN … NOT NULL with no default, so the refusal fails the whole object's sync (remote half of #37258)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As92T28dA9wc7wtu3iE
Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet · finding class b · reach: named producer (RemoteTransport.syncSchema / syncSchemasBatch on every hosted Turso/libSQL environment)

## What

`packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts` `columnDeclarationSQL` still emits `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN … NOT NULL` with no `DEFAULT` when a field declaring `storage.notNull` is added to a table that already holds a row. SQLite/libSQL refuses it ("Cannot add a NOT NULL column with default value NULL"), and the refusal fails the object's sync, through both doors (`syncSchema` and `syncSchemasBatch`).

The `storage.notNull` contract says: "Declaring this over existing null rows is a destructive migration gated by the schema-drift ceremony". So the add should land nullable and the differ should report `tighten_not_null`, which is what the local face does after PR #37279 (#37258).

## Evidence

- Measured by the #37258 dev (report: #37258 comment 7160587250): the remote half of case 4 in `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-remote-not-null.test.ts` still passes as "refused" at PR #37279 head `9995c0ec2d2`.
- After #37279 that test records the local/remote asymmetry as known (the local half flips, the remote half stays refused).
- Premise correction carried from #37258: SQLite accepts `ADD COLUMN … NOT NULL` on an EMPTY table; the refusal needs at least one row.

## Why its own card

The remote face carries an explicit `⛔ Never drop the NOT NULL` docblock stance from #23847. Reversing it on the populated-table path is a design change of that face, so it was kept off #37279 (seat ruling A, #37258 comment 7160678195). The docblock sentence "The local face sends the same statement and gets the same refusal" becomes false once #37279 lands.

## Acceptance

- Remote `syncSchema` and `syncSchemasBatch` add a `storage.notNull` column without a literal/`NOW()` default nullable when the table is populated, and the drift report shows `tighten_not_null`; empty tables and default-carrying fields keep `NOT NULL`.
- `turso-remote-not-null.test.ts` case 4: both halves assert the same outcome; the known-asymmetry note is removed.
- The `remote-transport.ts` docblock is rewritten to the `storage.notNull` contract.

Blocked-by: #37258
Dedupe: searched 'turso remote NOT NULL', 'columnDeclarationSQL', 'tighten_not_null' — nearest #23847 (closed, the stance this reverses), #23925 / #33724 (closed, other doors); no open card on this path.
